typed_links.link: The six ch.10 conquest notices split because each closes with entry-specific content and a migrating comparison target; the thirty-one-king register of 12:9-24 stays whole because the ehad tallies are bound into verse-pairs by accent position (zaqef/silluq), no entry carries its own closure, and one aggregate total closes the list.

Resumptive repetition marks continuity, not a new unit: the nine-word verbatim bracket at 21:3/21:8 folds the clan-totals insert into one unit (123 absorbs 124), the chiastic doubling at 22:6-8 holds 131 together, and 4:1's resumption of 3:17 closes the crossing narrative (016).

A repeated aleph-mem-resh formula opens a unit only when it carries an explicit subject reset or an accompanying content/register shift: 3:10's explicit-subject reset splits (151), 4:21's null-subject continuation does not (022), and the identical formulas at 24:19/24:22 divide only where the exchange turns.
